title: The merge tool and the CI wait read the GitHub rate-limit header they already receive and back off when it runs low
why: Real incident, Nov 13: the owner's GitHub REST quota hit 0 of 15,000 at 12:54 CST (reset 13:10 CST), stalling every runner and lane for about 16 minutes (retro read; unmeasured by triage).
note: Todo, a real incident. Retro's cause guess (unconfirmed): its two audit workflows, about 770 agent tool calls with many gh reads, took a large share; 33 or more live sessions poll too. Proposed: the merge tool and the CI wait read the `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header they already get; when it runs low they say so and back off. Audit briefs prefer local git reads over gh. A cost line, measured, not a fixed limit (owner R37: no hard fixed numbers). Needs a measure first: which callers spent the quota (log read on demand, no new log). A guard or check change: a build lane. Placed ahead of the rest of the queue 15:00 CST Nov 13 (retro 15:00, coordinator 14:58): the shared GitHub REST quota hit 15000 of 15000 twice today (12:54 and 14:59 CST, reset about 15:10), the second time blocking runner 10's express batch A and batch 141 builds. Every session's MCP reads, comments and PR writes stop until the reset; git reads still work. Same fault as step github-rate-limit-readers (folded in here): measure calls per session before the next wave. Still unmeasured, not read by triage. Lane 15:13 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 15:12): session_013NEJKzVtYq71orELDCuDRV, started 15:12 after the quota reset. Folds github-rate-limit-readers; told to stack on or fold step gh-get-timeout-retry. The 15:00 and 15:01 start failures ("service temporarily unavailable") cleared with the reset; cause not confirmed. Lane 18:57 CST Nov 13 (round 4 result, reviewer probe per the lane; unchecked by triage): the granted defect (780 c) is closed, but the same class remains: a low-quota reply on the batch-brake check can hold the merge call up to 900 s after that check, so a batch PR marked ready in the window is missed. Probe: pulls list low, pause 600 s, PR read, merge call landed. Lane's fix: serve any armed hold before the batch-brake read and arm none through the merge call. Needs a new owner word beyond the 780 c grant: page item 789 (a one more fix, b park, c review only). Lane waits; step blocked. Lane 20:05 CST Nov 13 (20:02-20:04): fresh review (sonnet) of head 361faeb3e found finding 1 (test double FakeHost lacks the new seams; a test fix, goes on) and finding 2 (a quota hold is still served after records_proof and holds_base and before the batch-brake read, so up to 900 s can pass between the base fetch and the merge call; strict is false, so a base push in that pause is not flagged). Lane fix for finding 2: serve the hold before the base fetch and keep holds off through the merge call. Grant 789 a (ruling own-789-a-round-5-one-fix) names "serve any armed hold before the batch-brake read and arm none from there through the merge call"; it does not name the base fetch, so finding 2 is held and asked as page item 794. Finding 1 continues. Owner 20:10 CST Nov 13 on item 794: c, park PR #3288 (ruling own-794-c-park-3288). No more work; the back-off does not ship; no review record posted. Lane session_013NEJKzVtYq71orELDCuDRV told to stop; coordinator asked to archive the lane and handle the branch. Lane stop notes 20:13 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 20:10; the lane's read, unverified): eight smaller notes are in the outbox under this step; branch gh-quota-budget-tests-r2 goes to archive/ via runner 10, then #3288 closes.
